instruments.name: Triangle Bass
instruments.description: The soft, round triangle bass of the NES, with a short release so lines stay tight.

instruments.name: Sub Bass
instruments.description: A deep sine with a gentle lowpass sweep, felt more than heard under the rest of the mix.

instruments.name: Solo Trumpet
instruments.description: A bright, centered lead trumpet that brightens as it speaks and slides gently between notes, with a late vibrato.

instruments.name: Orchestral Brass
instruments.description: A darker, rounder brass section than Jump Brass, for marches, fanfares, and big orchestral themes.
